rules_the_contract_must_carry: a region covering at least 55 percent of the page can never confer ownership
a fact reaches a region by containment, by a lattice cell or by a boundary drawn along it; never by being the nearest thing

a page without a text layer yields UNKNOWN, never an empty proof
